import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { parseFlyMailSendCommand, sendFlyMailThroughBackend } from '@src/response-apps/flyMail/send/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { resolveTargetUidFromArg } from '@src/utils/targetUid';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const uid = Number(e.uid);
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const parsed = parseFlyMailSendCommand(e.MessageText);

  if (!parsed) {
    return;
  }

  const targetUid = parsed.scope === 'friend' ? await resolveTargetUidFromArg(parsed.targetArg, mention) : parsed.targetUid;

  if ((parsed.scope === 'friend' && !targetUid) || !parsed.content) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(parsed.usageText);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '飞信', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  let result: { message: string };

  try {
    result = await sendFlyMailThroughBackend({
      bid,
      uid,
      scope: parsed.scope,
      targetUid: targetUid ?? undefined,
      content: parsed.content,
      request: createBackendRequestContext(e)
    });
  } catch (error) {
    result = { message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '飞信发送失败，请稍后再试' };
  }
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText(result.message);

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '飞信', content: md, footer: [{ label: '返回飞信', command: '/飞信' }] }));
});
